description: Common compliance-rule schema for a multi-vendor network security compliance auditor

rule_fields.title: Short human-readable rule title
rule_fields.framework: CIS, DISA-STIG, NIST, ISO-27001, or organizational policy
rule_fields.category: AAA, SSH, NTP, SNMP, logging, ACL, routing, interface, or other
rule_fields.check_type: presence, absence, value, pattern, relationship, or contextual
rule_fields.applicability: Conditions under which the rule applies
rule_fields.disallowed_configuration: Configuration state that should be flagged
rule_fields.evidence_pattern: Configuration pattern used to locate evidence
rule_fields.compliance_logic: Logic used to determine the result
